title: The Clarity Act stalled. Bankers aren’t hitting the brakes yet on crypto dealmaking
reason: Stall of the Clarity Act in the Senate is a significant regulatory development directly affecting crypto dealmaking.

sources.summary: Crypto M&A has hit record levels, but the Clarity Act’s Senate setback leaves dealmakers weighing how much regulatory uncertainty still matters.

title: Trump taps intel chief Jay Clayton to lead new Super Intelligence Force
reason: Presidential creation of a new AI task force led by a named official, corroborated by two sources, is a significant government AI policy move.

sources.summary: President Donald Trump said US intel chief Clayton will lead the SIF, reporting to the president and Chief of Staff Susie Wiles.
This new task force is Trump's latest response to the debate over AI safety.
